Before I finalize the arrangements, I'd like to do our routine planning check-in. I have two available workshop slots: October 9th from 1:00 to 3:00 PM, or October 10th from 10:00 AM to noon. I'm also considering Jordan and Priya as possible facilitators, and the workshop can be conducted either in person with a remote participation option, or entirely in person. Could each of you share any relevant commitments, access needs, or process requirements you have so I can make the best arrangements for everyone?
